concerns.text: Task T012 states 'synthetic redundancy injection' but lacks specifics on ensuring semantic validity, contradicting spec.md FR-002 which demands near-duplicate passages with cosine similarity > 0.95 *and* valid semantics.

Task T043 mentions validating the 'Semantic Similarity Threshold' but doesn’t define success criteria or how discrepancies will be handled, weakening spec.md FR-009 which requires validation against real-world data.
Task T025b lacks clarity on the specific values to be tested during the sensitivity analysis and what outputs are expected, making it difficult to verify completion.
Task T069 describes verifying the proxy validation chain but doesn't define *what* constitutes verification or how the output will be used beyond checksums; success criteria are missing.
